agyos_skill.instructions: A **strategy/relationship skill** — pick the partner, plan the cross-promo, write both sides. The agent **advises + drafts + plans**; **WoopSocial publishes each partner's own posts** on the coordinated schedule; the **co-created content + the relationship are native/human.** A collab's defining trait is **mutuality** — both creators contribute **and** both promote. That's what separates it from a sponsorship (a paid mention) and from brand→creator UGC. The growth comes from a **complementary-not-competing, similar-size (0.5–2×), values-aligned** partner — and from **agreeing the cross-promo plan before anyone creates.** Be honest about the shift: **bare shoutouts barely move the needle now** — **shared value beats shared exposure**, so co-create something real. WoopSocial's job is the coordinated **publish** of **each side's own posts**; the co-created content and the relationship are not things a scheduler can make. 1. **brand-profile** — niche / audience / values (for fit). 2. **goals-and-kpis** — the growth goal + the success metric (subs/followers per source). (Depth: `references/the-unite-framework.md`.) - **U — Understand the fit:** complementary not competing; 0.5–2× size; values-aligned + authentic (audiences spot fakes). - **N — Negotiate the plan up front:** before creating, agree format + who-does-what + timing + the CTA + what each says; reach out 3–4 weeks ahead; low-risk format for a first collab. - **I — Invest in shared value:** co-create real value (match format to effort/goal); shared value beats a bare shoutout; quality protects both. *(Co-created content is native/with the partner.)* - **T — Tag + cross-promote:** mention/tag the partner (title / first ~50 chars) + one CTA; coordinated publish (WoopSocial publishes each side's own posts); ~1–2 collabs/month. - **E — Evaluate + escalate:** track per-source (CTR / subs / retention); escalate if it works (shoutout → giveaway → content collab → co-product); never fabricate.
